name: Blue Thunder's Challenge

start.dialog: EL SCORCHO thinks he's the best! But I, EL AZUL, am the TRUE champion! You look tough! Fight me! If you win, I teach you my SPECIAL move! If you lose... you tell everyone I won! Deal?
start.objective: Defeat El Azul in a wrestling match

progress.dialog: Ready? The ring is prepared! The crowd waits! Let us RUMBLE!
progress.objective: Enter the ring and defeat El Azul

complete.dialog: IMPRESSIVE! You move like LIGHTNING! Here - BLUE THUNDER DROP! My signature! Use it with HONOR!

party_comments.kade: These luchadors are serious about their wrestling.
party_comments.twist: THAT WAS AWESOME! Do it again!
party_comments.grit: Good technique. The blue one favors speed over power.

hidden_outcome: If you win without using items, El Azul declares you his 'eternal rival' and gives you 'Blue Mask of Thunder' accessory
